case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70530.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
sup:70530.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
message.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

You asked for a clear basis for the next frame agreement. Our options give Selvbrunn what a pricing committee needs most: a binding volume over a longer contract term, so your planning is secure.

Option A is the package we can approve. It commits us to the full binding volume over the whole term, and the claims below show why the price sits where it does.

On the forecast:
Our forecast for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 rises 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).

On our price history with you:
Our orders of Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 with you were placed at EUR 414.61 on 2024-10-14 (po:4500011548-10), EUR 400.19 on 2025-06-30 (po:4500012634-10), EUR 412.74 on 2026-01-27 (po:4500013491-10) and EUR 412.74 on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014465-10): the price has not risen.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 84.6% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70530@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 418.79; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 416.33; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 415.11; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Binding volume in every option: 4,580 units a year over 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As this goes beyond your own authority, here is a paragraph your pricing committee can approve as it stands: Option A gives Selvbrunn a binding volume for the whole contract term, a longer period of planning certainty and a clear price for that period. Hollerau takes on the full volume commitment. Please take Option A to the committee. If it needs anything else to decide, tell us and we will provide it.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
message.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month volume, which provides mutual planning security and allows us to revise our offer. While we cannot accommodate the 90-day payment term from Option A or return to historical price levels, we are prepared to build on your Option C. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €431.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

We propose a unit price of EUR 429.43 for a 24-month contract with 45 days net payment. Alternatively, we can offer a price of €429.43 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
message.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

You wrote that you appreciate the commitment to a long volume, because it gives both sides planning security. That is exactly what our options are built on: a binding volume over the whole contract term, which is what your pricing committee can plan against.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Selvbrunn the longest firm commitment on volume and term, and it is the one we put forward as it stands.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 420.71; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 418.24; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 417.02; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As this goes beyond your own approval, we would ask you to take Option A to your pricing committee. For the committee: Option A gives Selvbrunn a binding volume every year over the whole contract term, a fixed term that secures its production planning, and an order we confirm without further rounds once Option A is approved as written.

We are glad to provide whatever your committee needs for its decision, in the form that suits it best.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
